name: Kirchenwirt
beschreibung: Kirchenwirt is situated right in the sunny village center of Schwoich near Kufstein, directly beside the historic parish church. This family-managed heritage inn has been a cherished gathering place for generations. Cozy rooms decorated in classic Tyrolean country style offer relaxing comfort after exploring the surrounding mountains. In the traditional dining parlors and the leafy outdoor beer garden, guests enjoy hearty regional specialties, fresh salads, and homemade pastries prepared with local farm ingredients. Its sunny plateau setting makes it an ideal hub for cycling, walks to Lake Hechtsee, and hiking in the Kaisergebirge.
kurzbeschreibung: Heritage village inn in Schwoich near Kufstein featuring a sunny beer garden and Tyrolean hospitality.
